newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy wants no rigid Stet shareholder core.
newsitem.headline: Italy wants no rigid Stet shareholder core.

text.p: Italy wants a stable shareholder core in telecommunications holding company Stet, which is due to be privatised this year, but not a rigid structure, Treasury undersecretary Laura Pennacchi said on Wednesday.
"The goverment intends to avoid rigidity," she told a hearing in the Chamber of Deputies (lower house), according to a preliminary official draft.
Pennacchi said "the government is looking towards big investors not pursuing interests of their own".
Stet is due to be merged with its fixed-line telephony unit Telecom Italia later this year ahead of the sell-off.
The government hopes to launch the privatisation by October, Pennacchi said.

She added that Telecom had recently initialled an international deal and was working on other accords to achieve a more international focus, Pennacchi was quoted as saying but no details were immediately available.
